changes: Initialized currentReviewRound for direct story_create --phase=REVIEW stories, improved missing-round diagnostics for review_run_start and review_loop_start, added field regression coverage, and documented the lifecycle invariant.
usage: Run lattice story_create with phase REVIEW for a review-only story, then run lattice review_run_start and lattice review_loop_start immediately; both commands should start against the initialized review round.
expectedOutcome: After direct REVIEW story creation, the terminal shows Review run B-xxxx:RR-001 started instead of a no currentReviewRound error.
actualTranscript:
Story B-f8a9 created (REVIEW) with 1 checklist items
Review run B-f8a9:RR-001 started for koala-review-quality (round 2026-06-11T23:50:13.429Z, head dc5f2b4)
Review loop B-f8a9:RL-001 started for B-f8a9 (round 2026-06-11T23:50:13.429Z).
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match: direct REVIEW creation now produces usable REVIEW metadata and both REVIEW commands start successfully.
limitations: No migration command was added for already-existing half-initialized REVIEW stories; they remain fail-closed with clearer repair/recreate guidance.
pitfalls: Direct REVIEW creation is still a compatibility path for review-only or backfill workflows, not a replacement for the normal INIT to DEV lifecycle when implementation work is required.
